Main_Finding: Coupon application failures were consistently identified in the feedback.
Recommended_Action: Investigate coupon redemption logic and test the promotion application process.

Main_Finding: App lagging and freezing during checkout were the main recurring problems.
Recommended_Action: Prioritise app stability and performance, especially during checkout.

Main_Finding: Checkout friction was frequently associated with app lagging or freezing and disappointing ordering experiences.
Recommended_Action: Reduce checkout friction and investigate technical issues affecting the ordering process.

Main_Finding: Delivery delays and delayed return pickups were recurring issues.
Recommended_Action: Improve delivery reliability and the return pickup process.

Main_Finding: Payment failures, billing discrepancies and inconsistent payment experiences appeared repeatedly.
Recommended_Action: Improve payment reliability and verify billing accuracy.

Main_Finding: Feedback was relatively balanced, although slow or unclear support interactions appeared in negative comments.
